annotations.title: Split a large order across perp DEXs (Pro, 1 USDC)

description: PAID: 1 USDC on Base per plan that saves at least 20 USD (free otherwise), via x402 (no account; an x402-enabled client pays automatically). How to split one side of a large market order across perp DEXs so each live order book only absorbs what it can: the size, fee and slippage of every leg, against doing it all on the single cheapest venue. You only pay when the split saves you at least 20 USD; below that the plan comes back free, and the first call already tells you the saving.

max_venues.description: Most venues to split across: each needs an account and margin (default 3)

monthly_volume_usd.description: Your 30-day volume in USD, to pick your fee tier (default 0)

pair.description: Base asset of the perpetual, e.g. BTC

side.description: buy (open long / close short) or sell

size_usd.description: Order size in USD (notional), one side
